name: NC Department of Insurance

plan.title: NC Department of Insurance Strategic Plan 2025-2029

mission.text: Safeguards North Carolina residents through insurance consumer protection, insurer financial oversight, marketplace regulation, and fraud control.

citation.document: NC Department of Insurance Strategic Plan 2025-2029

objectives.text: Administer licensing and investigate licensee conduct to ensure fair treatment of insurance purchasers.

citation.document: NC Department of Insurance Strategic Plan 2025-2029

objectives.text: Provide Medicare counseling through the Seniors' Health Insurance Information Program (SHIIP), with community partners and volunteers in every county.

citation.document: NC Department of Insurance Strategic Plan 2025-2029

objectives.text: Provide guidance and intervention for health insurance disputes and appeals.

citation.document: NC Department of Insurance Strategic Plan 2025-2029

objectives.text: Monitor insurer solvency and conduct financial examinations to protect consumers' financial interests.

citation.document: NC Department of Insurance Strategic Plan 2025-2029

objectives.text: Streamline rate and form filing reviews, conduct market conduct exams and promote captive insurance.

citation.document: NC Department of Insurance Strategic Plan 2025-2029

objectives.text: Strengthen insurance fraud enforcement through investigation and prosecution.

citation.document: NC Department of Insurance Strategic Plan 2025-2029

objectives.text: Integrate artificial intelligence into fraud detection and response.

citation.document: NC Department of Insurance Strategic Plan 2025-2029

wording_note: Goals and objectives are close summaries of the plan posted on the OSBM Agency Strategic Plans page (retrieved 2026-11-07); check the cited section before quoting. Keywords, search terms and usual funders were chosen by the team as matching aids.
